scopeLimitations: The personally viewed selected V2 original-project portrait is internal authority, not external historical proof. No absolute 1:1 certification.
Visible face, textile, sling and khipu surfaces qualified; concealed back anatomy and tiny knots remain unknown.
No numerical age or sex asserted from the image. Family-safe and non-romantic throughout; CG13 alone explicitly swaps gender presentation.
New settings are original compatible Andean high-road compositions; no claim to historical religious reconstruction.
Personally viewed old atlas is historical, visibly different: crescent crown, white dress, feminine face, no sling/khipu; it is not source authority.
observedIdentity: Bronze-skinned lean chasqui runner; black hair top bun with rust ribbon and long hair behind; woven rust/gold headband; rust tunic with gold border over black shorts; ochre cape with purple/gold bands and violet throat brooch; strapped calves and sandals. Anatomical RIGHT hand holds long rust-red brown loop sling; LEFT holds pale rectangular khipu support with long tan knotted cords and purple tips.
